YOUR QUICK TOUR

A room you can remix.

Walk: W/A/S/D or arrow keys. Click empty floor for mouse-look; Escape releases the cursor. Hold right mouse and drag to look without locking.

Furnish: Choose Add an object for beds, books, lamps, a bird, and more. Add multiple copies, rotate, adjust volume, or remove each one. Quiet furnishings stay silent. Your layout is saved in this browser; Reset room restores the starter bedroom.

Remix: Drag a colored source in the room or floor plan. Each track also has four placement arrows and a mute button.

Compare: Studio and Cathedral change the reverb of the same continuously playing performance.

Object recordings are supplied by SATIE / Attractor Labs. Piano and drummer displays are quiet because music is unavailable on this SATIE plan. Distance, direction, and room reverb are rendered by browser Web Audio.
BUILD YOUR LITTLE WORLD

Make room for something.

Objects appear in front of you. Drag them into place.
